set.notes: FNDDS survey foods. Not an analysis of dragon fruit: FNDDS 2021-2023 builds this food 100% from 'Fruit, NFS' (FNDDS food code 63100100), so the values are a generic fruit average.

why.evidence: USDA FoodData Central FNDDS 2021-2023 CSV (FoodData_Central_survey_food_csv_2024-10-31), input_food.csv row id 138756: fdc_id 2709234, sr_code 63100100 'Fruit, NFS', 100.0 g per 100 g
why.reason: Name suggests a dragon-fruit composition record; the source shows it is a generic fruit proxy.

why.evidence: USDA SR28 WEIGHT.txt, NDB 18029 (FDC 172675) 'Bread, french or vienna': seq 2 '1 slice' = 139 g (12 data points, SD 37.4 g). The portion belongs to the US French/Vienna bread record the estimate was copied from; no source gives a Maltese-bread slice weight.
